description: Decide whether a business must register for Cyprus VAT, applying the 15,600 euro rolling twelve month threshold, the article 11(1) treatment of services received from abroad which carry no separate threshold, intra-community supplies which carry none either, and the position of businesses not established in Cyprus.

established_in_cyprus.description: True if the business is established in Cyprus. A business not established here has no registration threshold.

makes_intra_community_supplies.description: True if the business supplies goods or services to businesses in other EU member states.

services_received_from_abroad_last_12_mo.description: Value of services bought from suppliers outside Cyprus in the same period.

taxable_supplies_last_12_months.description: Value in euro of taxable supplies made in Cyprus over the preceding twelve months. For example 18000.

name: cyprus_vat_registration_test
title: Test whether Cyprus VAT registration is required
